items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: So, Quank would play with us all the week

ctx.x: So, Quank would play with us all the week, now, then he played on a Sunday, because we were waiting this week, on a Sunday, he played with, with the Olympic band, but our record drummer was working in the Jewish store, when he played with us on Sundays, on a record drummer, see? Now, Henry Martin played with the Olympic band through the week, with all the outside jobs, Quank played them, see? And we were waiting, see, like, I feel like I want to, you feel like you want to change. I'd slip off and go on over to…
Where did they have those quadrilles, in the other halls, like at Conor Manion?
